feat.claim: Aqua attempts purification of a corrupted hot-spring source and helps overcome the poison slime; her divine purification has enormous specialised impact.

rank.basis: Duke of Hell with foresight, devastating magic, possession and enough extra lives that he cannot count them.
rank.limits: Can lose a manifested body; holy purifiers are dangerous and clairvoyance has exclusions.

feat.locator: Natsume Akatsuki character Q&A (pre-volume 17), Vanir: extra lives; main novel volume 3, castle/dungeon incident
feat.claim: Vanir claims so many accumulated extra lives he cannot remember the number; destruction of one manifested body is not permanent defeat.

rank.basis: Extremely powerful lich mage with devastating spellcraft, drain touch and unusual undead survival.
rank.limits: Holy purification remains a critical counter; shopkeeper outfit is not a separate power form.

source.rights: © Natsume Akatsuki, Kurone Mishima / KADOKAWA / KONOSUBA Production Committee. All rights reserved.

rank.basis: Royal training, inherited magic and exceptional combat potential established in the novels.
rank.limits: Official portrait is civilian dress; no Aigis armour or ultimate equipment is claimed here.

rank.basis: Exceptional one-shot destructive Explosion magic capable of defeating formidable enemies.
rank.limits: Normally unable to cast again without rest or externally supplied mana.

source.rights: © Natsume Akatsuki, Kurone Mishima / KADOKAWA / KONOSUBA Production Committee. All rights reserved.

rank.basis: Advanced, flexible elemental magic, tactical awareness and reliable repeat casting.
rank.limits: Less peak one-hit destructive output than Explosion magic.

rank.basis: A powerful swordfighter using the divinely granted magical sword Gram.
rank.limits: Power is weapon-dependent; removing Gram drastically changes this assessment.

rank.basis: Near-unmatched damage absorption, endurance and exceptional physical strength.
rank.limits: Attacks seldom connect; durability must not be mistaken for reliable offensive output.

rank.basis: Excellent luck and tactical skill; Steal, Bind, Drain Touch and combinations compensate for lower stats.
rank.limits: Not a direct physical equal of top generals; Demon King victory is highly conditional.

rank.basis: Exceptional luck, movement, stealth, escape and thief utility.
rank.limits: This is not unrestricted Eris; hidden divine identity does not automatically grant full heavenly authority.

rank.basis: Competent court mage and royal escort with sustained spellcasting.
rank.limits: Not established above elite archwizards in direct offence.

rank.basis: Gifted Crimson Demon magic student before developing her later Explosion-focused combat specialization.
rank.limits: Early academy form; must not receive late-series repeated Explosion feats.

rank.basis: Newly acquired top-tier Explosion magic and strong raw magical potential.
rank.limits: Single cast exhausts her and battle experience is still limited.

rank.limits: Earlier training stage lacks mature archwizard mastery.

rank.basis: Advanced spell training with a versatile combat toolkit compared with the average adventurer.

rank.basis: Surprising affinity for dangerous creatures and summoned entities, with natural Crimson Demon talent.
rank.limits: Her summoning success is situation-dependent; she lacks proven sustained duelling feats.

rank.limits: School-era student; no inferred late-series ultimate techniques.
